title: 23-BCV-011 — Polyethylene film for greenhouse enclosures (R1 and superseded issue)

facts.text: R1 applies to commercial greenhouse facilities governed by NBC(AE), under Article 3.1.18.5.
R1 has a staff-only option and a public-access option; both require film flame-spread rating not exceeding 25.
facts.locator: R1 PDF pp.1–2, Variance options 1 and 2

facts.text: The public option includes one-storey/Group F Division 3 scope, sales-related access, aisle and exit-width requirements, occupant-load basis, signage/spatial separation and a fire-safety plan.
The February 2025 issue was limited to greenhouses not intended for the public and is marked superseded; the catalogue lists R1.
facts.locator: Historical PDF pp.1–2; catalogue row/API metadata

facts.text: The October 2026 R1 resource was added/modified in the catalogue API on 2026-10-15; both current and superseded resources have API state active.
facts.locator: Official catalogue API resource metadata, retrieved 2026-10-24 America/Edmonton
